name: metabase-ai-assistant
description: The most powerful MCP Server for Metabase — 143 tools with dbt semantic layer, governance-first business memory, autonomous self-healing SQL & enterprise BI.
long_description:
Connect Claude to your Metabase instance with 143 specialized tools.

**Features:**
- dbt Semantic Layer & Model Hierarchy Awareness (Marts > Intermediate > Staging)
- Governance-First Semantic Memory (Propose/Approve, Soft-Deprecate, Audit History)
- Autonomous Self-Healing SQL execution & AI generation
- Autonomous End-to-End Dashboard Architecting
- Proactive Anomaly & Outlier Detection
- AI Query Index & Materialized View Advisor
- Enterprise PII & Sensitive Data Sanitizer
- Schema exploration & relationship detection
- User & permission management
- Export/import workspace migration

Requires a running Metabase instance with API access.

metabase_api_key.title: Metabase API Key
metabase_api_key.description: API Key for authentication (recommended). Generate from Metabase Admin > Settings > API Keys

metabase_username.title: Metabase Username (Email)
metabase_username.description: Email for username/password auth (used if API Key is not set)

read_only_mode.title: Read-Only Mode
read_only_mode.description: Restrict to read-only operations (recommended for safety)

internal_db_id.title: Internal Database ID
internal_db_id.description: Metabase Application DB ID for advanced analytics (use meta_find_internal_db tool to discover)

metadata_enabled.title: Enable Metadata Analytics
metadata_enabled.description: Enable advanced metadata analytics tools (requires Internal Database ID)
